import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars1 = ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax1.bar_label(bars1, fmt='%.1f')

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs BMI Category
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
bmi_quality = df.groupby('BMI Category')['Quality of Sleep'].mean()
colors2 = ['#2ecc71', '#f39c12', '#e74c3c']
bars2 = ax2.bar(bmi_quality.index, bmi_quality.values, color=colors2)
ax2.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality by BMI Category')
ax2.bar_label(bars2, fmt='%.1f')

# 3. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
colors3 = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors3, explode=[0.05]*len(disorder_counts))
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')

# 4. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                      c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', s=150, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality')

# 5. Stress Level vs Heart Rate by BMI
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax5.scatter(subset['Stress Level'], subset['Heart Rate'], label=bmi, s=150, edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax5.set_title('Stress Level vs Heart Rate by BMI')
ax5.legend(title='BMI Category')

# 6. Correlation Heatmap
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
numeric_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=ax6, 
            fmt='.2f', square=True, linewidths=0.5)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Heatmap')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
